shared_ancestry_note: FRANK C6, Clay G10, ClayGraph C4, GWT R4, Hyperposition H4, Emergenz E1, prior ClayCode and Fusion R4 share substantial RAE ancestry. Agreement is convergence, not independent replication.

frank.delta: Refine the C6 Clay View Compiler into a Certified Multi-Rail Semantic Compiler: preserve P1 canonical Clay, permit separately versioned DISCRETE_NATIVE/P2 and LATENT_NATIVE/P3 cognition rails, and require return-to-canonical reconciliation before durable truth/effects. Projection receipts must bind both canonical source and exact emitted view.
frank.evidence_class: direct generic-4B runtime + local discriminating fuzz + independent compiler/latent communication literature
frank.next_experiment: Exact target-Qwen full-FT P0/P1/P2/P3/hybrid factorial with retained-capability, OOD, latency/token and authority-violation measures

clay.delta: COVE remains the trusted semantic-slice compiler. Add MRSC after the canonical COVE basis so reader/cognition rail selection is operation- and reader-specific; rail planners cannot enlarge the trusted slice and lossy views may omit only semantics outside required closure.
clay.evidence_class: COVE generic-4B measurement + CC11 loss-budget calibration
clay.next_experiment: Cross operation families compare raw, canonical-direct and rail-planned views at fixed gold/basis with reader/cost profiles

claygraph.delta: Keep exact anchors, semantic epochs, activation and Assemblies separate. Explicitly distinguish ClayGraph latent_activation_field (memory salience) from model LATENT_NATIVE (neural cognition/communication). Dense/latent similarity may retrieve/rerank but cannot define directed/n-ary identity, semantic class, truth or capability. Persist receipts/anchors and canonical proposals, not raw latent bytes as truth.
claygraph.evidence_class: ClayGraph C4 + direct NVIDIA embedding negative control + MRSC architecture synthesis
claygraph.next_experiment: Pinned semantic epoch factorial crossing graph latent field OFF/truthful/shuffled with model latent rail OFF/truthful/shuffled; exact-anchor validation held fixed

gwt.delta: Extend CSOC with rail/view medium as an independently pinned or randomized causal stage. Same canonical WorkspaceEpisode communicated via canonical, discrete-native, latent-native or hybrid rail is not the same reader-side intervention, and rail changes must not be bundled with workspace selection lesions.
gwt.evidence_class: GWT R4 causal identifiability + Interlat mechanism transfer + MRSC
gwt.next_experiment: WORKSPACE_SELECTION x RAIL_MEDIUM x PROJECTION_DETAIL x REENTRY factorial with identical canonical episode semantics

hyperposition.delta: H4 semantic firebreaks are strengthened: each rail carries exact class/role/anchor/basis witnesses, but runtime hot paths may lower them to compact typed handles. No implicit P2/P3 -> FACT/AUTHORITY/EFFECT cast. Add exact emitted-view identity to projection firebreak receipts.
hyperposition.evidence_class: H4 synthetic/mechanism work + CC11 dual-binding fuzz + NVIDIA dense-geometry negative control
hyperposition.next_experiment: Packed-handle Rust/C benchmark plus cross-rail alias/class/role mutation fuzz under live/twin effect paths

emergenz.delta: Extend E-CERT2 identity and lesion controls to communication rails. Latent performance, symbol stability, cross-rail agreement or protocol convergence are not emergence evidence. For P3, require message-content substitution/zero/foreign-task lesions plus mechanistic rescue/OOD and matched training/extra-pass controls.
emergenz.evidence_class: E1 method + latent communication literature + negative/control reasoning
emergenz.next_experiment: Preregister one target latent-message motif and run truthful/shuffled/zero/foreign-message lesion-rescue-OOD with pinned P1 semantics and reader identity

claycode.delta: Advance OPEN research candidate from CC-RC1.5 ICSL to CC-RC1.6 MRSC. Keep ICSL/CBCC/COVE intact; add rail planning, dual-bound discrete ProjectionReceiptV2, LatentChannelReceipt, RailReturnProposal and canonical ReconciliationReceipt. No promotion until target-reader and live/runtime gates pass.
claycode.evidence_class: multi-source synthesis + generic 4B measurements + local executable reference/fuzz
claycode.next_experiment: Exact target-Qwen multi-rail factorial, then stateful/property fuzz and translation-validation implementation in target runtime
